items.title: Humana (HUM) Backs 1,000 Indiana Home Health Aide Scholarships
items.summary: Humana (NYSE:HUM) is sponsoring 1,000 Home Health Aide scholarships in Indiana and launching a broad collaboration with HealthStream to address caregiver shortages. The effort targets recruitment, training and retention of home-based caregivers, with a focus on underserved and rural communities. items.title: DaVita and Humana Expand Kidney Care Partnership to More Than 10,000 Patients
items.summary: DaVita (NYSE:DVA) has expanded its partnership with Humana (NYSE:HUM) through a new value-based care agreement covering more than 10,000 Medicare Advantage members living with chronic kidney disease. The programme, which launched on July 1, targets patients with stages 3B through 5 chronic kidney disease (CKD).
